en.muhajir-b-ali: 116. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
One who circumambulates around this House (i.e. the Ka'bah) seven times, Allah will write for him six thousand good deeds and erase six thousand misdeeds and elevate him six thousand degrees.
According to Ibn 'Ammar's narration, 'And fulfill for him six thousand needs.'
